title: Remarks in accepting the saddle and bridle presented by the citizens of Cheyenne, and the horse presented by the citizens of Douglas, Wyoming
paragraphs: I thank you most heartily. I thank my friends of Cheyenne for the beautiful western saddle and bridle. I thank my friends of Douglas for this beautiful horse. I accept them with the greatest pleasure. I am going to take the liberty of re-christening the horse "Wyoming", to commemorate this state; and I shall be proud in Washington, at the capital of the nation, to be riding so fine a range [?] horse with the saddle and bridle of the cow country--the best that the cow country can produce. I have broken in the saddle already. I rode the horse yesterday; and I wish to say that I have never been on so easy gaited a horse who could keep that gait at so good a speed over fairly rough ground. It is like sitting in a rockingchair to ride him; and yet, he has good speed and he is tough and enduring. I thank you from my heart. The horse and saddle will serve always to commemorate as pleasant a forty-eight hours as any President has ever passed since the White House was built. (Cheers and applause)

The handwritten margin note at the top left reads "File" and "not given out", with a diagonal stroke. "branded" is struck by hand; a hand mark follows "range" and a hand vertical stroke crosses the first hyphen of the typed dash after "country". "in" after "broken", "enduring." and "horse and saddle" are handwritten; "horse and saddle" is written below the struck sentence, directly above "y will serve", and replaces the "y" of "They", which is struck by hand. Third look: "branded" is heavily inked out; a second heavy stroke runs just below "range" and a hooked hand mark follows it, so it cannot be told whether "range" is also cancelled. The hand writing above "I could" is "enduring" (its final "g" loops over "could"), not a separate word. The strike through the sentence begins with a hook around "I", runs through "could ... pleased", and on the next line a blot covers "more" and touches the "e" of "be"; the whole sentence "I could not have had gifts that would have pleased be more." is read as cancelled. "horse and saddle" sits in the space above "They will serve" and goes in place of the struck "y".
